typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_Folder_Path as string (),
	Created_DateTime as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Environment as string (),
	ExecuteStoredProcedure as string (),
	File_Type as string (),
	FullFilename as string (),
	MarketCode as string (),
	MarketID as integer (),
	MarketName as string (),
	Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	Record_Count as integer (),
	Report_Date as timestamp (),
	Report_Run_Date as timestamp (),
	Source_Path as string (),
	StoredProcedureName as string ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet FROM ##IA_EVV_PRIOR_AUTH_EXTRACT ORDER BY RowIndicator DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of ResultSet} = ResultSet) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet = {Copy of ResultSet})) ~> FlatFileDestination
